find.f_photo.title: Photo at the workbench
find.f_photo.text: An old snapshot: Grandpa stands at this very workbench in his work apron, laughing. Someone must have made a joke before he could put on a serious face.
find.f_screws.title: A box of screws
find.f_screws.text: Screws sorted by size, each slot labelled in his handwriting. Grandpa never threw anything away without a reason: everything comes in handy one day.
find.f_note.title: A note in the cabinet
find.f_note.text: A folded slip between the shelves: "The most important thing is behind the cabinet." Grandpa's handwriting, a little hurried, as if he remembered at the last moment.
find.f_radio.title: Evening tune
find.f_radio.text: The radio crackles and suddenly finds a familiar tune. Grandpa played it in the evenings, when he finished work and poured himself some tea.
find.f_clock.title: Engraving on the clock
find.f_clock.text: An engraving on the back of the clock: "To the master, from his first customer, with gratitude." This clock is where it all began.
final.title: The workshop is alive
final.text: The light is on, the clock is ticking, the radio plays softly. The workshop is alive again. And behind the next door there is a smell of paint: there seems to be more work to do.

find.f_drawing.title: A child's drawing
find.f_drawing.text: A crayon drawing: a house, the sun and Grandpa with a huge brush. He kept it in the table drawer, carefully covered with tracing paper, like a real painting.
find.f_palette.title: A paint palette
find.f_palette.text: A palette with dried paint: honey, sage green and a warm red. Grandpa painted everything he fixed in these colours.
find.f_sign.title: A sketch of a sign
find.f_sign.text: A sketch of a sign for the workshop: the letters have nearly faded, but you can see how carefully Grandpa drew every curl.
find.f_apron.title: A paint-stained apron
find.f_apron.text: An apron stained in every colour hangs on a nail. It seems Grandpa painted not only furniture but himself too, and never minded it a bit.
find.f_brush.title: An old brush
find.f_brush.text: An old brush with a handle wrapped in tape. Grandpa mended even the things he painted with, and it still lays an even coat.
final.paint.title: The workshop is alive again
final.paint.text: It smells of wood and fresh paint, the clock is ticking, the radio plays softly. Both rooms are full of life again, and the workshop's story goes on. Thank you for being here.
intro.paint.title: The paint room
intro.paint.text: This is where Grandpa painted what he fixed. This room has its own parts: paints. Matching paints combine on the table just like fasteners.
